sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: This example demonstrates how to configure the XCLKOUT pin for driving internal clocks through an external pin, for debugging and testing purposes.
In this example, we are using INTOSC1 as the XCLKOUT clock source configuring the divider as 8. Expected frequency of XCLKOUT = (INTOSC1 freq)/8 = 10/8 = 1.25MHz
View the XCLKOUT on GPIO73 using an oscilloscope.

simplesect.para: The pin used in this example is not available on the HSEC board.
